# Violet Alert Protocol
1. All medical personnel are to be secured in the medical bay immediately.
2. The Chief Medical Officer's safety will take priority over curing an infection.
3. Virology will focus all efforts on identifying the pathogen and producing the appropriate treatment or vaccine with its laboratory chemistry equipment.
4. Medical entrances should be locked down to prevent further infection of medical personnel.
5. Any potentially infected personnel should be isolated and quarantined.
6. Any pacified infected personnel should be brought to Virology containment to aid diagnosis and treatment production.
7. A cure should be distributed to the crew once available, in a controlled manner.
